mentions.name: Podium
mentions.description: A cloud development environment for running coding agents, built around a task management system that lets agents split large jobs into subtasks and run each one on a different agent, model, or machine. Progress is visible at a glance, and tasks can run autonomously for long stretches (weeks at a time) with only occasional steering input to the coordinator.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a development environment to run coding agents in the cloud. There's a lot of other products in this category. What makes ours really special IMO, is the built-in task management system. Your agent can split up large jobs into subtasks itself and run each one on a different agent / model / machine.
mentions.author: mgw
